specs.name: insertionSort_empty
specs.stmt:
∀ (h_precond : insertionSort_precond []),
    insertionSort [] h_precond = []

specs.name: insertionSort_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond [x]),
    insertionSort [x] h_precond = [x]

specs.name: insertionSort_length_preserved
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    (insertionSort xs h_precond).length = xs.length

specs.name: insertionSort_mem_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs) (a : Int),
    a ∈ insertionSort xs h_precond ↔ a ∈ xs

specs.name: insertionSort_isPerm
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    List.isPerm xs (insertionSort xs h_precond) = true

specs.name: insertionSort_sorted
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    List.Pairwise (· = ·) (insertionSort xs h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_sorted'
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (insertionSort xs h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_cons_perm
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond (x :: xs)),
    List.isPerm (x :: xs) (insertionSort (x :: xs) h_precond) = true

specs.name: insertionSort_cons_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond (x :: xs)),
    (insertionSort (x :: xs) h_precond).length = (insertionSort xs trivial).length + 1

specs.name: insertionSort_eq_mergeSort
specs.stmt: theorem insertionSort_eq_mergeSort : ∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs), List.Perm (insertionSort xs h_precond) (List.mergeSort xs)

specs.name: insertionSort_perm
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    List.Perm xs (insertionSort xs h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_idempotent
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    insertionSort (insertionSort xs h_precond) trivial = insertionSort xs h_precond

specs.name: insertionSort_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond args),
    insertionSort_postcond args (insertionSort args h) h

specs.name: insertionSort_sorted
specs.stmt: insertionSort_postcond l (insertionSort l h) h

specs.name: insertionSort_perm
specs.stmt: theorem insertionSort_perm : List.Perm (insertionSort l h) l

specs.name: insertionSort_length
specs.stmt: (insertionSort l h).length = l.length

specs.name: insertionSort_nil
specs.stmt: insertionSort [] h = []

specs.name: insertionSort_eq_mergeSort
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    insertionSort xs h_precond = List.mergeSort xs

specs.name: insertionSort_eq_mergeSort
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    List.Pairwise (· = ·) (insertionSort xs h_precond) ∧
    List.isPerm xs (insertionSort xs h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_perm
specs.stmt:
∀ (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond xs),
    List.isPerm xs (insertionSort xs h_precond)
